description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database viewer interface, containing styles, structure, and client-side script for interacting with a database visualization backend.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data as an HTML table, adding interactivity.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell, handling large objects and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell with long content or objects.
